newsitem.title: THAILAND: More soymeal to arrive in Thailand in February.
newsitem.headline: More soymeal to arrive in Thailand in February.

text.p: At least 25,900 tonnes of soymeal and 8,000 tonnes of other protein product for animal feed will arrive here in February, shipping sources said on Thursday.
Three vessels from India have declared the arrival so far for next month, they said.
Vessel Dali is scheduled to arrive at a Thai port in February 2 with 8,200 tonnes of soymeal and 33,488 tonnes of groundnut meal.
Hallard and Song Shan are expected to arrive later in the month with 17,700 tonnes of soymeal, 2,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal and 3,000 tonnes of groundnut meal, the sources said.
